first_B_layer_mean_rel_bias_pct is (weighted-unweighted)/unweighted = -68.0224%, while prose says it shows how far the legacy unweighted summary was off
deuteron_fraction_abs_bias_pp is weighted-unweighted = -40.5851 pp, while the legacy-minus-weighted direction is +40.5851 pp

recommended_semantics.weight_policy: Reject missing, empty, nonfinite, negative, or zero-total event weights; never substitute unit weights or fall back to an unweighted estimator.

repository_evidence.inspection_method: Authenticated GitHub blob and ranged file reads. The executable audit was run on a faithful current-source excerpt plus the tracked numerical values because the connector does not materialize repository files into the local runtime.

required_remediation: Replace unit-weight coercion and invalid-weight fallbacks with fail-closed validation.
Emit both directional percentage comparisons with explicit denominators and signs.
Regenerate the report and plots from the exact ROOT bytes.
Record ROOT SHA-256, producer commit, command, environment, and weight-policy version.
Propagate weighted uncertainty or resampling diagnostics before using the shifts as claims.
scientific_boundary: This audit does not rerun the one-million-event ROOT study, prove that the first primary is the intended event-weight carrier, quantify weighted uncertainty, or establish data/MC closure. The retained numerical comparison remains scientifically useful only as a flagged diagnostic until a strict content-addressed rerun is produced.
